name: Infoblox — DHCP ACK Activity (Baseline, Disabled)
xql_query:
datamodel dataset = infoblox_infoblox_raw
| filter xdm.event.type = "DHCP" and xdm.event.description contains "DHCPACK"
| alter mac = arrayindex(regextract(xdm.event.description, "([0-9a-fA-F]{2}:[0-9a-fA-F]{2}:[0-9a-fA-F]{2}:[0-9a-fA-F]{2}:[0-9a-fA-F]{2}:[0-9a-fA-F]{2})"), 0),
        ip  = arrayindex(regextract(xdm.event.description, "DHCPACK on (\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+)"), 0),
        hostname = arrayindex(regextract(xdm.event.description, "\((\S+?)\) via"), 0)
| filter mac != null and ip != null
| bin _time span = 24h
| comp count_distinct(mac) as new_devices,
       values(ip) as tgt_ips,
       values(mac) as device_macs
       by hostname, _time
| fields tgt_ips
description: Infoblox DHCPACK events grouped by hostname — informational baseline. DISABLED by default because DHCP fires on every device-join (5k+/day). Keep available as a pivot query for case investigation, but not as an active detection.
